name: CDFW CRFS all-species and all-effort historical catch-per-angler blocks

rights.license: CC BY (version not specified by California open-data catalog)

spatial.horizontal_crs: Service EPSG:3857, transformed to WGS84 for approximate browse-sector review

temporal.update_cadence: Monthly full-page edition and schema check; human review before any derived public context

evidence.supports: CDFW metadata defines all-species/all-effort scope, one-minute interview-reported blocks, multi-block allocation, five-year bins, three-trip inclusion rule and CC BY catalog license.
Direct service inspection found 6,936 records, Catch=All and Trip=All, 2021–2024 CPUA fields and one oversized public polygon.

limitations: Both catch and trip categories combine every species and fishing method. This source cannot provide lingcod or rockfish-specific evidence or validate an individual habitat patch.
The geometry is one-minute interview-reported area, not a catch coordinate. Multi-block trips divide reported catch across their listed blocks.
2021–2024 CPUA is a four-year aggregate. Samples is for the entire 2004–2024 period, not its recent denominator. -9999 is unavailable rather than zero.
One public polygon, OBJECTID 4098 BlockBox 489-233, spans about 0.044 degrees longitude and is excluded from the spatial review pending clarification.
Blocks with fewer than three reported trips over the full period are omitted. This dataset is historical sampling-coverage context only; no fishing target, rank, route or export derives from it.

producer.name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife, California Recreational Fisheries Survey

provenance.access_service: CDFW ArcGIS FeatureServer for BIOS ds3186
transformations: Pin source edit timestamp, required fields, 6,936-record count and every ordered page digest.
Transform valid public polygons to WGS84 and group only into broad approximate latitude browse sectors; exclude the reviewed oversized polygon.
Count positive, zero and unavailable 2021–2024 all/kept CPUA separately; keep raw blocks unpublished and out of spot rankings.
